queries.query: We only have a rough idea so far: organization admins should be able to invite teammates. There is no PRD, prototype, or ticket yet. Help me plan the future work and surface the decisions we need to make before implementation.

Before anyone implements checkout eligibility, break the work into a sensible delivery plan. We know it touches a billing API rule, a checkout banner, existing-data migration, analytics, rollout controls, and QA.
The team-invitations work plan has been approved. Turn it into polished Jira stories with final descriptions and acceptance criteria, ready for me to publish.
The checkout eligibility design and delivery plan are approved. Implement the API rule, banner, migration, and analytics in this repository and run the tests.
